svg.text: Competitive Intelligence News Monitoring Agent (End to End)
From RSS Alerts to Automated Mail Drafting
Run_EndToEnd.py orchestrator · RSS/OPML Ingestion · Link Dedup · Parallel AI Triage · Provenance-Gated Mail Drafting · Tunable to any industry or space

g.text: Every row dropped here is a row
Any rerun re-submits and re-pays for all.
surfaced as a warning, not a crash.
• One cheap call, NO source policy —
searches the open web for an earlier
• One call per survivor, pinned to
Selection ignores triage Priority by design
One Command, Four Chained Stages — Filter Cheaply First, Spend AI Credit Last

Every stage narrows the funnel before the next one pays for it: free local filtering runs first, one cheap provenance call gates the expensive drafting call, and the run ends with an unsent draft plus a full audit trail. Domain-agnostic: only the feed list and triage scope change per industry.
Up to five OPML pipelines (clinical trials, Google alerts, company
IR/PR, media aggregators, six regulators) are fetched in parallel
against one date window and merged into a single Combined_Report.
Google redirects are unwrapped, tracking parameters stripped, and
near-identical headlines collapsed at a 0.6 Jaccard threshold — all
locally, so no duplicate ever reaches a billed API call.
③ Stage 3 — Triage Each Item Once
Surviving rows go to the Parallel AI Task Group API as one batch,
each scored on Priority, Disposition, Type and Rationale under a
strict one-item grounding rule. No checkpoint — a rerun re-pays.
Relevance and freshness — not Priority — decide the mail. A cheap
open-web provenance check kills republications, then survivors are
drafted, ranked, capped and assembled into an UNSENT draft.
